resources.string: WorkPause
WorkPause visible fallback
Fallback only. Used to flip the Work apps tile when the silent MODIFY_QUIET_MODE permission has not been granted via ADB.
Schedule events
Notifies when the scheduler fires.
Work profile unlock reminders
A tappable reminder after scheduled resume. Banners depend on Android notification settings.
Unlock your work profile
Work time has started. Tap to open a work app and enter your work PIN if Android asks.
Work profile is scheduled ON
Android accepted the resume request. If work apps still need your work PIN, tap to open one.
Open work apps
Choose a work app below. Android handles any required work PIN; WorkPause never reads it. After unlocking, the selected app opens.
Choose the work app you want to open. If the profile is still paused, tap Resume work profile first.
Resume work profile
Open WorkPause settings
This reminder is no longer active. WorkPause is off, work hours have ended, or the profile has unlocked. Use your normal work-app icons.
No accessible work-app icons were returned by Android. Try Resume work profile, or open a work app from your phone launcher.
Android or your employer blocked access to work-app icons. Open a work app from your phone launcher instead.
Silent control is not available. Use your phone controls to resume the work profile, then open a work app.
Android has not finished resuming the profile. Complete any Android credential screen, then return and try again if needed.
Android could not open this work app. It may have been removed or restricted. Use the work-app icon in your phone launcher.
Your saved location rule could not be verified. WorkPause will not resume the profile from this reminder.
